expo.name: TriAdapt
expo.description: Your adaptive AI triathlon coach. TriAdapt turns workout data into structured sessions and personalized coaching that adapts to the athlete's training, readiness, goals, and schedule.

infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: TriAdapt uses the camera to capture watch screens and workout boards.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: TriAdapt uses the microphone to log sessions by voice.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: TriAdapt uses photos of watch screens and whiteboards to log training.
